data.name: Kantharaj
data.gender_notes: Kantharaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kantha means throat and Raja means lord. This name is derived from the Hindu god Shiva, who is believed to control the throat chakra. It is believed that those named Kantharaj have the power to communicate effectively and persuasively. The name Kantharaj carries the meaning “Lord of the throat” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kantharaj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the throat and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the control over communication and expression.
data.etymology: Kantharaj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the throat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kantharaj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
